preserve_v1_safety.notes: Bridge reads explicit v2 DBs only and does not change v1 runtime/schema/MCP/defaults.

prevent_uncontrolled_writes.notes: Capability policy denies writes; bridge writes only response/audit artifacts to caller output directory.

prevent_cross_project_leakage.notes: Policy requires allowed space_key and project_path; missing or mismatched scope is denied.

expose_provenance.notes: Search/explain include score components and evidence when requested/required; rehydrate embeds RehydrateResponseV1.

support_replay.notes: Audit includes request hash, policy hash, response hash, DB hash/path, trace id, retrieval config, and adaptive config.

adaptive_scoring_opt_in.notes: Adaptive scoring is disabled by default and denied unless policy explicitly allows it.

rollback_cutover_gates.notes: Architecture doc lists rollback and cutover preconditions; cutover remains blocked.
